We once discussed veterinary medicine from the perspective of how humans came to the idea of helping other living creatures while spending their own time and resources on it. Strictly speaking, this mostly applies to pets, because in the industrial world veterinarians often work with farm animals. Today I want you to think about how incredibly complex this science really is. A veterinarian has to understand the anatomy and physiology of dozens of different species in order to help them. From a tiny aquarium fish to a massive python, any creature may need care, and it is honestly impressive how veterinarians manage to keep all of this knowledge in their minds while making decisions that can determine the fate of their patients. Veterinarians save tens of thousands of beloved pets and prevent epidemics among farm animals, which in many ways also means protecting human populations. Thank you, veterinarians. #Veterinarian #Medicine #Animals #edit #Pets

This place grills the gopchang thoroughly over a briquette fire, so there is absolutely no gamey smell, and it features a deep, subtle smoky flavor. I ordered the Al-gopchang, which is cleanly stir-fried with just veggies and tripe. Pairing it with a refreshing glass of Somaek (beer and soju mix) was truly an incredible combination! With the nice and cool weather these days, I highly recommend visiting this place to enjoy some bouncy, spicy gopchang as a snack and have a drink!🍻🔥 #서울맛집 #동대문맛집 #KoreanFood #Seoul #Dongdaemun

Recette brunch :  Recette pancakes :  - 135g farine  - 3 œufs  - 200 ml lait  - 45g sucre  - 1 sachet levure chimique  Fouetter les œufs le sucre et le lait et rajouter la farine tamisée et la levure bien mélanger jusqu’à ce qu’il n’y ait pas de grumeau.    Recette 12 cupcakes : - 150g de beurre pommade  - 150g de sucre en poudre  - 3 œufs  - 150g farine - 2 cac levure chimique  Fouetter le beurre et le sucre jusqu'à obtenir un mélange onctueux puis ajouter les œufs un par un et enfin rajouter la farine et la levure chimique. Remplir les caissettes au 3/4 puis enfourner 10 à 15 min selon le four à 180 degrés  Recette chantilly mascarpone :  - 350g mascarpone  - 40 cl crème fleurette minimum 30%  - 3 cas de sucre glace  - 1 gousse vanille  - 1 CAS arôme vanille  Placer les ustensiles et les ingrédients liquide 5/10 min au congélateur si possible, plus c’est frais, mieux c’est, tout mixer ensemble avec un fouet électrique

Ultra Creamy Buldak Ramen 🍝🥟 Ingredients 1 pack Buldak ramen 1–2 tbsp butter 2 cloves garlic (minced) 1 tbsp Kewpie mayo Buldak sauce packet Buldak powder packet 1 tbsp chili oil ¾–1 cup heavy cream Mozzarella cheese Dumplings Sausages Green onions Sesame seeds Extra chili oil (for topping) Instructions Cook noodles until al dente, then drain and set aside. In a pan, melt butter over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add Kewpie mayo, Buldak sauce, and powder packet. Mix well until it turns thick and glossy. Add chili oil and stir. Pour in heavy cream and mix until smooth, creamy, and slightly thickened (that rich orange color 🔥). Add noodles and toss until fully coated. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top and let it melt into the sauce. Add dumplings and sausages on top. Cover and let everything heat through. Finish with green onions, sesame seeds, and extra chili oil drizzle. . #buldak #buldakramen #eat #cook #Foodie

Dumbbell Sumo Squat  Know the difference  1. Dumbbell Position Hold the dumbbell with both hands naturally hanging between your legs, rather than holding it at your chest. This allows you to lift heavier weights without being limited by arm strength. 2. Torso Posture Maintain a slight forward lean instead of staying fully upright. Leaning forward increases hip flexion, helping to stretch and better activate the glutes. 3. Stance Width and Foot Angle Set your feet about 1.5 times shoulder-width apart, with your toes pointing outward at roughly a 45-degree angle. If the stance is too wide, the inner thigh muscles (adductors) will take over, reducing glute activation. 4. Load Path As you squat down, the dumbbell should not stay directly under your shoulders. Instead, it should fall slightly behind the midline, closer to your posterior chain. Bring your hands slightly inward to keep the load closer to your center of mass, which helps reduce lower back strain and improves movement efficiency. #gymtips #quads #gluteworkout #gym #gymrat
